i2a_source_validation.scope: Native source path, JSON byte/depth/value-count and common record envelope rejection fixtures, with local dense parser cost probes. This slice alone does not qualify semantic F3 closure, combined allocation/RSS or durable admission.

i2a_manifest_identity.scope: Pure JCS/SHA-256 manifest identity from supplied exact-byte metadata with a 100k-entry local cost probe; staged-byte verification, F3 closure and durable source admission remain unbuilt.

i2a_manifest_writer.scope: One canonical emitter now feeds both SourceRevision hashing and a fallible streaming writer. Exact small-manifest bytes match an independent JCS oracle, a failing writer reports its error, and a local 100,000-entry writer cost/RSS probe passes. No stage-byte closure, SQLite manifest blob or admitted root is implied.

i2a_provisional_stage.scope: Native complete-tree inventory and provisional exact-byte staging with local budget, drift and old-reader fixtures; no F3 schema/dependency validation, durable source admission, cook or save.

i2a_bootstrap_semantics.scope: Narrow direct-decoded project/empty-scene schema and stable-ID reference proof over rehashed staged records with a provisional manifest revision; no general F3 registry, durable admission or runtime consumption.

i2a_meaning_lineage.scope: Pure allocation-free linear comparisons of sorted field-meaning and type-version histories, with local 100,000-field cost sample and missing/changed/revived/stale-branch/duplicate rejection fixtures; hashes are opaque inputs here, and descriptor parsing, authenticated prior root and durable admission remain unbuilt.

i2a_definition_hashes.scope: Pure first-profile JCS/SHA-256 field and type-version definition hashes with independent oracle and local 32,768-field/256-version cost sample; staged-tree registry/history consistency, authenticated predecessor and durable admission remain unbuilt.

i2a_schema_record.scope: Direct bounded one-record core.schema decoding with strict known keys, sorted at-most-128 fields and canonical first-profile hashes, plus local 256 maximum-descriptor parse sample; no staged declaration/path verification, registry/history consistency, game-record validation or durable admission.

i2a_registry_history_record.scope: Direct bounded one-record core.registry-history decoding with sorted at-most-100,000 field and 1,024 version entries, strict lowercase hashes and local dense parse/RSS probe; no staged declaration/path verification, active-descriptor consistency, authenticated predecessor or durable admission.

i2a_registry_consistency.scope: Pure linear allocation-free join of parsed active descriptors to parsed source field and type-version history with missing/retired/changed/orphan rejection fixtures; no staged-tree declaration/byte verification, authenticated prior history, game-record closure or durable admission.

i2a_carried_lineage.scope: Pure monotonic comparison directly over two parsed source-carried history vectors without copying entries, with local 100,000-field/two-buffer cost and process RSS samples; current admitted predecessor authentication, full combined parser/graph allocation qualification and durable admission remain unbuilt.

i2a_project_v2_declaration.scope: Direct bounded core.project schema 2 decoding of sorted scene/game record, schema, history and entry-scene declarations, with a local 4,096-record/256-schema cost sample; no staged membership/ID closure, game-record validation or durable admission.

i2a_game_record.scope: Direct first-profile descriptor-fed game-record validation with bounded strict optional opaque JSON, typed reference summary and descriptor hash provenance, plus local dense/deep/wide parser cost/RSS probes; no staged source verification, target resolution, source-editor round-trip or durable admission.

i2a_staged_registry.scope: Provisional staged core.project schema 2, declared core.schema and source-carried history records are rehashed and joined for reserved path membership, unique registry record IDs and active field/version consistency. Project and descriptor inputs reuse one byte buffer; a local small-tree repeated validation cost is recorded. Scene/game record semantics, references, authenticated predecessor, combined allocation/RSS qualification and durable admission remain open.

i2a_staged_records.scope: Provisional staged core.scene and one-descriptor game records are rehashed and parsed with a reusable byte buffer; project and registry IDs are unique with scene/game IDs, and entry scenes and required typed references resolve locally. A small-tree repeated closure cost is recorded; multi-schema dispatch, maximum combined parser/graph memory, source-editor opaque round-trip, authenticated prior lineage, manifest and durable admission remain open.

i2a_provisional_candidate.scope: One provisional staged registry and scene/game closure derive a JCS/SHA-256 manifest with checked record identity labels and captured exact-byte metadata. An independent small-tree oracle, A/B revision test, local small-tree release probe and a 4,096 declared-record count probe pass. Ordinary bytes need durable rehash; maximum parser/graph memory, editor opaque round-trip, authenticated prior lineage, multi-schema dispatch, durable admission and cook/run remain open.

i2a_opaque_text_edit.scope: One descriptor-validated game text edit carries untouched optional JSON values with exact raw spelling, revalidates stable identity and required references, and changes a fresh provisional candidate revision while the old stage remains unchanged. A local 4 MiB optional-value edit cost probe passes; no coordinated file application, general editor, combined allocation/RSS qualification, authenticated prior root or durable admission.

i2a_dense_candidate_cost.scope: Isolated local macOS arm64 runs measure a 4,096-record one-descriptor candidate with full 100,000-field/1,024-version carried history and 8.3 MiB opaque game record, plus a separate 256-descriptor staged registry and direct game parse. Peak process RSS and validation elapsed are reported; this does not qualify the full combined allocation/RSS peak, authenticated prior, 65,536-edge case or multi-schema game dispatch.

i2a_sqlite_transaction_proof.scope: Test-only native SQLite file store verifies selected page, incremental-vacuum, WAL, FULL synchronous and main-page-count settings, then tests one atomic generation/retry-outcome transaction across reopen, same/different token, stale generation and injected outcome failure. It stores supplied digest bytes only; no verified blob closure, authenticated predecessor, physical reserve, crash/process-kill proof or accepted-source API exists.

i2a_sqlite_blob_proof.scope: Test-only SQLite 4 MiB chunk storage verifies stored exact length, hash and chunk layout before complete-state publication; a root refuses missing/incomplete blobs. Partial-input retry, complete-hash reuse, final verification/reset exclusion and stale-writer rejection are tested across two connections. Arbitrary test bytes are not a semantic source closure, and production disk/WAL budget, old roots, authenticated lineage, crash recovery and accepted-source API remain open.

i2a_staged_lineage.scope: Two checked provisional registries reread and rehash their source-carried history files, compare permanent fields and immutable type versions without copied entry vectors, and reject deletion from a supplied predecessor. A local two-buffer 100,000-field cost/RSS probe passes; current admitted-root authentication, physical reservation and durable source admission remain open.

i2a_manifest_blob_bridge.scope: A small test-only canonical TreeManifest is written to bytes, verified as a complete SQLite blob, committed as root digest with outcome and recovered exactly after reopen. This fixture buffers the small manifest and does not check its referenced source file blob, authenticated prior lineage, physical budget, crash durability or general accepted-source closure.

i2a_manifest_chunk_writer.scope: A test-only bounded writer emits canonical 100,000-entry manifest bytes directly to four verified 4 MiB SQLite chunks. A smaller two-chunk fixture checks root/outcome and reopened stored digest. Local Rust 1.99.1 release cost/RSS is recorded, but referenced file closure, prior-root authority, physical disk/WAL reservation, process-kill recovery and production admission remain open.

i2a_direct_file_closure.scope: A test-only manifest root transaction checks every direct file entry against a completed SQLite blob hash and exact length. Missing or mismatched files refuse before root/outcome advancement, while matching retries recover the persisted outcome. No authenticated prior history, dependency closure, disk/WAL reservation, pins, process-kill recovery or production admission API exists.

i2a_small_blob_batch.scope: Test-only small immutable blobs stage in groups of at most 128 files and 1 MiB input bytes; input and stored hashes are checked before one SQLite transaction commits. Rollback, reuse, reopen and manifest-root closure pass. Local 1,000-file release helper timings are recorded, including a one-file storage tail; physical WAL peak, process-kill recovery and full source admission remain open.

i2a_stored_root_lineage.scope: Test-only recovery verifies the current root revision, exact canonical manifest bytes and one complete history blob, then compares source-carried fields and type versions under a generation precondition; a changed root loses final CAS. Corrupt chunk/layout/hash, wrong project and stale lineage refuse. A 100,000-entry local decode/root-read cost and RSS probe passes. Candidate staged-byte provenance, GC pins, physical reservation, kill recovery and production admission remain open.

i2a_staged_candidate_lineage.scope: A test-only validated one-scene candidate supplies history only after its staged file is reread and rehashed; a same-length post-validation mutation refuses. Complete-blob reuse verifies supplied bytes with one lazily sized reusable scratch buffer. Local 1,000-file new/batch/reuse helper timing and RSS are recorded. Full candidate file staging, GC pins, physical reservation, kill recovery and production admission remain open.

i2a_candidate_root_proof.scope: A test-only three-file validated candidate passes staged-byte verification, current-root lineage, complete file/manifest blobs and atomic root/outcome generation commit. A/B edit, drift/lineage/stale/token refusal, reopened retry and concurrent same-token winner pass; local edit-to-root timing/RSS is recorded. Configurable disk planning, actual-space-fault recovery, GC pins, process-kill recovery, game-schema breadth and production admission remain open.

i2a_sqlite_physical_growth.scope: A test-only candidate path batches staged files of at most 4 KiB through the bounded 128-file/1 MiB SQLite writer while preserving staged-byte hashes, root CAS and retry. Local release measurements compare logical main/WAL lengths for a 4 MiB blob, 1,000 tiny blobs, complete reuse and an unblocked truncate checkpoint; matched batched and individual tiny-file stores differ 26.8x in WAL length. This is not a worst-case physical admission reserve, allocated-block/free-space proof, blocked checkpoint, kill recovery or production API.

i2a_candidate_space_preflight.scope: A test-only prewrite candidate check charges each distinct missing file/manifest hash, current SQLite logical/main/WAL lengths, existing checkpoint debt and actual available volume space. Injected main/WAL/free-space limits refuse without a blob or root write; local 100,000-entry fresh/populated and one-file/large-store costs are recorded. The planning allowance is not a proven physical upper bound; per-write WAL guard, temporary recheck, reserve lock, process-kill recovery and production API remain open.

i2a_wal_backpressure.scope: A test-only guard checks WAL length before blob, batch, verification and root writes, with nonblocking PASSIVE/TRUNCATE attempts and bounded repeated PASSIVE work. A pinned-reader test proves blocked checkpoint defers a new blob before its header, matching retry/conflict and complete reuse remain available, and retry succeeds after drain. Per-transaction page-growth allowances are heuristic; the earlier hard-cap policy was superseded by configurable planning targets. Production concurrency, observed high-water and actual-space-fault recovery remain open.

i2a_chunk_kill_recovery.scope: A local two-process test kills a child after the first 4 MiB SQLite blob chunk commit and before complete-state publication. Reopen preserves the prior selected root, exposes one incomplete chunk, refuses its root publication, and permits full verified restage plus a new root across reopen. This does not test final-transaction kill, assembled source candidate recovery, power loss, GC pins or production acceptance.

i2a_root_transaction_kill.scope: A local child process is killed after root-generation and retry-outcome SQL writes but before SQLite commit. An independent reader and post-kill reopen see the old generation and no new outcome; the same request then commits both and survives reopen. This is one test-only open-transaction interruption, not a power-loss flush proof, full candidate recovery, physical reserve or production API.

i2a_game_candidate_root.scope: One five-file test candidate carries a game-owned descriptor, its immutable history, a game record with optional exact JSON bytes and a required local scene reference through validated staging and SQLite root/outcome publication. A/B caption edit, reopened exact game bytes, same-token retry and invalid-reference refusal pass. Local tiny edit-to-root timing is recorded; editor application, multi-schema/external dependency closure, GC pins, physical bound, cook/run consumer and production acceptance remain open.

i2a_root_read_pin.scope: A test-only current-root reader registers one durable revision pin in a short transaction before out-of-transaction manifest/history decode, retains it across root advance/reopen, and releases it after success or validation refusal. Failed release under writer contention retains an in-process ID for next-read or explicit retry; non-reused IDs avoid stale cleanup. Local 100,000-entry read cost is recorded. No collector enforces transitive closure, abandoned-pin recovery, staged pin or production admission yet.

i2a_gc_mark_probe.scope: A test-only mark snapshots the selected root and durable read pins, decodes each verified canonical manifest outside a long SQLite read transaction, and records unreachable complete-blob candidates only if a root/pin epoch still matches. Tests cover root advance, release, publication and pin races, plus a 128-candidate refusal limit that preserves old marks. A partial covering index keeps incomplete headers out of the at-most-4,096-complete-blob inventory scan; an 8 MiB WAL allowance remains heuristic. No deleting state or chunk removal, staged/save/build/release owner pins, abandoned-pin recovery, scalable batching or production GC exists.

i2a_live_free_floor.scope: The test-only candidate path activates a live volume-free check after initial preflight and runs it before every guarded write and checkpoint. It charges the configured free floor, incoming heuristic transaction allowance and uncheckpointed logical-to-physical main debt. Injected post-preflight shortage refuses before a blob header, and a checkpoint-boundary shortage leaves WAL length unchanged; local tiny-edit smoke cost is recorded. This does not guarantee SQLite/VFS growth, concurrent actors or the configurable WAL/free-space planning targets.

i2a_sustained_blocked_wal.scope: A test-only SQLite reader holds a WAL snapshot while repeated 4 MiB blob writes approach an injected 40 MiB stop. The guard spaces PASSIVE work, defers a chunk, leaves the selected root unchanged, and retries the same hash after the reader drains. One local release run records completed writes, WAL length and elapsed time before deferral. It does not qualify multiwriter coordination, process/power loss, a production admission path or the configurable WAL/free-space planning targets.

i2a_one_descriptor_profile_audit.scope: The first checked provisional staged-candidate subset used one active game descriptor, finite record/optional-value work bounds, rehashed local scene/game reference closure, canonical revision and exact opaque-value preservation during a known-field edit. Registry parsing separately accepts up to 256 descriptors; a follow-on two-descriptor dispatch proof is recorded separately. Dense one-descriptor validation and separate 256-descriptor registry RSS/cost probes are observations, not a process-memory gate. Full 256-descriptor game dispatch, external roots, general editor application, consumer reconciliation, full combined peak-allocation qualification and production admission remain open.

i2a_two_descriptor_dispatch.scope: A provisional seven-file staged candidate dispatches two game record types through sorted source-carried descriptors by a bounded top-level JSON type pass, then performs full descriptor validation and local required-reference closure. One-descriptor candidates retain a direct parse path. Unknown type/version, nested type spoofing, duplicate/unsupported envelope keys and deep/dense invalid fields refuse; older staged bytes survive source edits. The two-descriptor edit cost, full 256-type game distribution and combined peak, external roots, consumer reconciliation and durable admission remain open.

i2a_256_descriptor_candidate_cost.scope: An ignored release fixture validates a full provisional candidate with 256 descriptors, 4,096 declared scene/game records, 100,000 field-history entries, 1,024 version entries and one large opaque game value, then derives its canonical manifest revision. One local elapsed sample and an isolated whole-process RSS sample are recorded. Only one game record and one required edge are live; all-type game distribution, 65,536-edge overlap, authenticated prior root, editor/source-store peak, target/device performance and production admission remain open.

i2a_native_space_plan.scope: User-selected native disk thresholds are configurable planning targets rather than hard physical caps. The provisional staging API accepts a SourceSpacePlan; fixtures prove early refusal under a low temporary target, successful capture under a raised target, and a small-source WAL estimate below the full unused stop target. SQLite admission, actual host-volume fault recovery, cross-platform high-water measurement and accepted source remain open.

i2a_sqlite_full_recovery.scope: Two test-only SQLite faults use a low max_page_count to produce genuine SQLITE_FULL during a validated candidate blob write and inside a root/outcome transaction after its root-row update. Reopen retains the previous root and no new outcome; the same requests commit after removing the injection. Host-volume exhaustion, a full-candidate final-commit fault, power loss, collector pins, cross-platform high-water and production accepted source remain open.

i2a_all_type_max_edges_candidate.scope: An ignored release fixture validates one provisional candidate with 256 source-carried game types, two records per type, 3,584 scenes and 65,536 distributed required references under dense carried history, then derives its revision. A 65,664-edge candidate refuses. Three isolated local elapsed/RSS observations include fixture generation and staging in whole-process RSS but time only validation. Authenticated prior root, external roots, two-candidate/editor/store peak, target performance and production admission remain open.

i2a_first_profile_consumer_handoff.scope: Design reconciliation of the bounded local source profile with F4, T1, W1/F1, P7 and N1: distinct accepted source, ready build, active world/match and private save roots; explicit refusal and retention behavior; a small edit-to-restore proof queue and an initial append-only native authoring retention profile with collector deletion disabled. No consumer implementation, general external dependency resolver, production source admission, collector reclamation or runtime qualification is claimed.

i2a_all_type_candidate_overlap.scope: One ignored release fixture keeps two full 256-type, 4,096-record, 65,536-edge provisional candidates and their 100,000-field histories live, compares lineage and matching revisions, then measures unchanged restage and validation/lineage times plus three fresh-process RSS peaks on local macOS ARM64. This pessimistic overlap does not authenticate a prior root, run SQLite/editor application or measure edit-to-ready.

i2a_native_source_store.scope: A public native append-only SQLite store admits only validated staged candidates after full staged-byte rehash, authenticated current-root lineage, unique complete file/manifest closure, selected space-plan checks and one root/outcome generation transaction. Reopen checks root/outcome identity; current and historical-outcome pins authenticate the canonical manifest and stream file chunks with bounded scratch and final hash verification. Local tests cover retry, stale/conflicting token, final-outcome rollback, incompatible store refusal, corrupt/output read refusal, multi-chunk old-root pin retention and a drained WAL overrun. Three local release runs measure ten small store admissions and pinned scene copies. This does not qualify arbitrary external dependency roots, editor application, host-volume/power-loss durability, cross-platform physical high-water, collector deletion, cook/run/save or edit-to-ready latency.

i2a_native_disk_followup.scope: The public append-only store is exercised under genuine test-injected SQLiteFull during a candidate blob write and final root/outcome transaction. Both reopen with the old root and no new outcome, then retry successfully after removing the injection. A 12 MiB candidate defers while a reader blocks WAL checkpointing and succeeds after drain. An optional usage query reports apparent SQLite main/WAL lengths, logical/freelist pages and observed volume available bytes; three local release small-edit runs sample post-admission lengths and timing. This does not prove host-volume I/O fault recovery, allocated-block or transient physical high-water, prolonged reader-blocked operation, platform VFS durability or a hard storage cap.

i2a_native_commit_io_recovery.scope: One test-only native VFS post-sync final WAL COMMIT fault proves the older accepted-store candidate quarantines its failing connection, leaves its read pin untouched and resolves B by exact outcome on fresh open. Automatic and last-close checkpoints are disabled on that connection. This is single-owner orderly-reopen evidence; other open connections are not quarantined, and writer-lock/reconciled authority, power-loss, volume-fault and cross-platform qualification remain open.

i2a_native_shareable_lease.scope: The accepted-source pin retains an Arc owner and short mutex-protected SQLite phases. A multi-chunk A copy admits B through the same owner during the first consumer write and still verifies A's exact bytes; a second pin reads after its store handle drops, then releases before reopen. Decode, hashing and consumer writes run outside the owner mutex. A test-only post-sync final-COMMIT fault with a live lease refuses later lease SQL, retains A's pin and recovers B's exact key after reopen. A poisoned owner refuses with RecoveryRequired. Independent connections, process lock, format-2 reconciliation, cross-owner uncertainty recovery, collector deletion and assembled performance remain open.

i2a_native_owner_lock.scope: The accepted store takes an exclusive cooperating fs4 sidecar lock before SQLite open, canonicalizes the database parent, refuses Unix hard-link aliases, and retains the lock through its Arc owner and final lease. A second process and a same-process parent-path alias open refuse Busy; a killed holder releases the lock. During a focused live-lease post-sync final-COMMIT fault, another opener is Busy until the quarantined owner and lease drop; fresh open recovers B by exact key and retains A's pin. This is a local cooperative-lifecycle proof, not hostile path defense, Windows path-identity qualification, full public-admission process interruption, format-2 reconciliation, power-loss proof, physical-space bound or assembled cost qualification.

i2a_accepted_head_audit.scope: Accepted format-1 open now compares the selected root with the indexed top durable outcome and refuses a duplicate latest generation. A public A/B admission fixture mutates the stored selection back to A while B's outcome remains, then injects a duplicate B generation; both fresh opens refuse CorruptStore. The check is an indexed top-two read rather than a full history scan. Coherent database rollback, older-row audit, format-2 intent/migration, full crash recovery and physical planning remain open.

i2a_one_accepted_api.scope: The separate format-2 ProvisionalSourceStore is compiled only for in-crate tests, so NativeSourceStore is the sole production-facing accepted-source store export. The full repository gate still runs provisional recovery and fault fixtures and the cook/headless accepted consumers. This is a public-boundary cleanup, not migration of provisional databases or qualification of complete accepted-admission interruption, physical planning or general source closure.

i2a_accepted_stage_kill.scope: A child process using the production accepted candidate-admission core is killed after B's staged file and manifest blobs are verified, before final root/outcome commit. Fresh open under the cooperating owner lock sees A selected, no B keyed outcome and a complete retained B manifest; public retry commits B while an A lease retains exact old scene bytes. This is one local precommit interruption point, not final-COMMIT process-kill, host power-loss or complete RecoveryRoot qualification.

i2a_accepted_lost_response.scope: A child process commits B through public NativeSourceStore::admit, then is killed before reporting success. Fresh owner open recovers B by exact epoch/key/request hash, same-request public retry returns B without generation advance, changed request conflicts and historical A remains byte-exact. This is an orderly local process-kill point after successful COMMIT, not inside-COMMIT interruption, host power-loss or complete application recovery.

i2a_native_owner_local_cost.scope: Three local optimized runs each time ten public three-file accepted admissions, pin/scene-copy/releases and fresh owner opens after ten edits with the cooperative lock and indexed selected-head audit. Three further runs time one 12 MiB public admission with an A lease live and a pinned B copy. A coordinated existing A reader waits roughly 87–89 ms behind B's large admission in three local runs. The record reports timings and post-admission SQLite lengths; it does not isolate lock syscall or calibrated mutex overhead, representative reader tails, transient allocated-block peak, RSS, cook/compiler path or device performance.

i2a_constant_light_source.scope: Provisional staged F3 constant-light schema 1, scene schema 2 and light identity use fixed built-in definition hashes, bounded direct parsing and typed UUID closure; test-only SQLite root probes reopen two exact revisions, preserve the prior root on invalid candidates, read pinned A after root/checkout advance to B and refuse corrupt stored bytes. A local 4,096-record paired timing probe shows no established cost change. Production admitted-source lease, F4 product, editor round-trip, assembled memory/latency, runtime, visuals and device qualification remain open.

i2a_constant_light_cost.scope: Seven fresh-process samples each compare matched 4,096-record provisional baseline, one selected constant light, 2,047 unselected source/light pairs and byte-heavy opaque selected workloads. Candidate elapsed ranges overlap; process CPU and peak RSS include other work. The retained source and raw samples establish no speedup, regression, maximum-source memory gate, edit-to-ready budget, durable admission, F4 or device qualification.

i2a_authored_rain_schema_proposal.scope: An isolated proposed schema-2 authored-rain/fixture grammar has pinned candidate built-in meanings, independent Rust/Python typed and global closure checks, exact rational phase coverage, adversarial refusals and local parse/RSS measurements. It does not change production dispatch or qualify admitted source, F4 products, first-hit exposure, runtime exchange, R0 ambient/background closure, visuals or device cost. C09/F3/F4 adoption remains open.

i2a_provisional_verified_store.scope: An in-crate test-only provisional SQLite store takes F3-validated staged candidates, verifies copied bytes and canonical manifest, commits keyed outcomes, atomically pins the selected revision and hash-checks bounded record reads. A/B, reopen, retry, corruption, last-owner and bounded tiny-file batch cases pass. A single local 1,005-file probe reduced fresh transaction count and elapsed time but increased WAL length; physical peak, full RecoveryRoot, schema pins, accepted-source authority, F4 and runtime qualification remain open.

i2a_provisional_publication_recovery.scope: Format-2 provisional intent persists before blob staging and commits selection/outcome/completion together.
